name: Pialligo Estate
reason: Winery/cellar door by appointment; visitcanberra lists it only among many wineries (winery rule).
objection: A landmark estate with restaurant could be a stop, but no source singles it out.

name: Canberra District Wine Region
reason: A region of 140 cellar doors, not one place a visitor goes for half an hour.
objection: Visit Canberra gives it its own page, so it is a real draw as a region.

name: Tharwa
reason: Wikivoyage Tuggeranong and Country ACT gives Tharwa Village its own listing: oldest ACT settlement, old bridge, gateway to Namadgi and Tidbinbilla (opened and read).
objection: Small declining village; the visit is half an hour of wandering.

name: Tharwa Bridge
reason: Part of Tharwa: Wikivoyage mentions the old bridge only inside the Tharwa Village listing.
objection: A 1895 heritage bridge is photographed and walked across; could be its own stop.

name: Cuppacumbalong Homestead
reason: Wikivoyage names only 'Cuppacumbalong Pottery' at Tharwa, a craft studio/shop; no source gives homestead tours.
objection: Historic pastoral property with a Wikipedia article.

name: Mugga-Mugga
reason: Wikivoyage lists the 1830s cottage with guided tours, but open only 10AM-2PM the first weekend of each month (opened and read).
objection: Against: not there whenever you arrive, one source, small. For: real heritage site with tours.

name: Geoscience Australia Education Centre
reason: Wikivoyage: free geology displays of minerals, fossils, Mon-Fri 9-5 (opened and read); one source, a short visit.
objection: Against: government agency foyer, niche. For: free, weekday daily, something to see.

name: Mount Ainslie
reason: Agency page names the summit (road, walk, bike) and Wikivoyage's North Canberra calls Ainslie Lookout Canberra's most important lookout, with the axis view to Parliament House (opened). Mount Ainslie Nature Reserve is the reserve of this peak.
objection: Overlaps Red Hill/Black Mountain as city lookouts; the walking tracks are part of it.

name: Red Hill Nature Reserve
reason: parks.act.gov.au agency list (parks-act-leads.json, relied on): 3.2 km Red Track loop with Red Hill Lookout over central Canberra.
objection: Local reserve; lookout alone is a short stop.

name: Black Mountain Nature Reserve
reason: parks.act.gov.au agency list (parks-act-leads.json, relied on): many walking tracks and city views, reached from the Botanic Gardens. Keep as the reserve; any tower or lookout on it is part of it.
objection: Overlaps with Black Mountain Tower if listed separately.

name: Aranda Bushland Nature Reserve
reason: parks.act.gov.au agency list (parks-act-leads.json, relied on): named Frost Hollow to Forest Walk, 1-2 hours.
objection: Against: suburban bushland, one source, no guide singles it out. For: agency-named walk.

name: O'Connor Ridge Nature Reserve
reason: Small 57 ha suburban reserve; agency names no walk or lookout worth a trip.
objection: It is an agency-listed reserve.

name: Rob Roy Range Nature Reserve
reason: Restricted access; much is leased land closed to the public.
objection: Agency lists it as a nature reserve.

name: Molonglo River Reserve
reason: Agency Murrumbidgee/Molonglo page names it with walking tracks; one source, no specific sight named.
objection: Against: unspecific, one source. For: a named reserve with tracks.

name: Namarag
reason: Part of Molonglo River Reserve; a recreation hub under restoration with nothing named to see.
objection: Agency names it as its own recreation area.

name: Tharwa Sandwash
reason: parks.act.gov.au agency list (parks-act-leads.json, relied on): scenic picnic area on the Murrumbidgee in Gigerline Nature Reserve; keep this and reject Gigerline as the container.
objection: Against: picnic area, one source. For: agency-named riverside stop near Tharwa.

name: Gigerline Nature Reserve
reason: Container of Tharwa Sandwash, the named visitor place; duplicate of it.
objection: Whole reserve is agency-listed.

name: Blue Range Hut
reason: parks.act.gov.au agency list (parks-act-leads.json, relied on): historic hut in Lower Cotter Catchment; nothing in the lead says what there is to see or how to reach it.
objection: For: historic hut the agency names. Against: little to see, one source.

name: Pierces Creek Forest
reason: Pine plantation; no named walk, lookout or sight.
objection: Agency lists it as a recreation forest.

name: Tuggeranong Pines
reason: parks.act.gov.au agency list (parks-act-leads.json, relied on): riding and walking forest in Canberra's south.
objection: For: used for mountain biking and walking. Against: a plantation, one source.

name: Melrose Nature Reserve
reason: Reserve near the NSW border with nothing named to see or do.
objection: Agency lists it in Canberra Nature Park.

name: Black Mountain Peninsula District Park
reason: Lakeside district park; no guide singles it out beyond the agency list (urban park rule).
objection: Lakeside peninsula is pleasant and is on Lake Burley Griffin.

name: Canberra Nara Peace Park
reason: parks.act.gov.au agency list (parks-act-leads.json, relied on): Japanese garden with lantern in Lennox Gardens on the lake; part of Lennox Gardens District Park.
objection: Against: small, one source, a garden inside a district park. For: distinct themed garden.

name: Canberra Beijing Garden
reason: parks.act.gov.au agency list (parks-act-leads.json, relied on): Chinese garden in Lennox Gardens on the lake, a distinct garden from Nara Peace Park.
objection: Against: small, one source, near-neighbour of Nara Peace Park. For: distinct garden.

name: Floriade
reason: Annual spring flower festival: an event (rule 4); the permanent place is Commonwealth Park, judged separately.
objection: The festival is a headline Canberra draw.

name: Summernats
reason: Annual January car festival: an event.
objection: Major draw while on.

name: Canberra Balloon Spectacular
reason: Annual March balloon event: an event.
objection: Draws many visitors, but only in March.

name: Hartley Hall Markets
reason: Monthly Sunday market: not there whenever you arrive.
objection: Three counted sources; 200 stalls.

name: Canberra Stadium
reason: Sports stadium open for events only; no tour named.
objection: Hosts major matches.

name: Manuka Oval
reason: Cricket ground for matches; no tour or museum named.
objection: Prime Minister's XI ground in guides.

name: Canberra Theatre Centre
reason: Performing venue as a building; nothing to see between shows.
objection: Civic Square landmark in guides.

name: Royal Military College, Duntroon
reason: Wikivoyage: grounds open to the public (most buildings restricted), with Changi Chapel built by POWs on Miles Road (opened and read).
objection: Against: working military college, restricted buildings, one source. For: open grounds, a named chapel.

name: Capital Hill
reason: Duplicate of Parliament House, the place visitors go to on this hill.
objection: Hill is a named landmark.

name: Anzac Parade
reason: Wikivoyage North Canberra describes the 1.1 km avenue and a 2 km memorial walk to the War Memorial (opened); judged as the one avenue, with its individual memorials rejected as parts.
objection: Memorials alone are minor, but the avenue is a walk guides describe.

name: Hospital Hill Lookout
reason: Wikivoyage Namadgi lists the Boboyan Road lookout with interpretive signs and mountain views (opened); not a hospital.
objection: Against: roadside pull-out, one source. For: a guide names it.

name: John Knight Memorial Park
reason: Wikivoyage Belconnen lists the 12 ha lakeside park with the 'Snake House' play structure, water garden, free barbecues (opened); not a memorial.
objection: Against: local family park. For: guide names several features.
